CRS Marketing Solutions Pty Ltd are seeking an experienced and motivated full-time Analyst Programmer to join our team. The successful applicant will be responsible for analysing business and system requirements, developing software solutions, and maintaining applications that support our business operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Analyse business requirements, existing systems and operational workflows to design data solutions
Design, develop and implement scalable Python and SQL-based data solutions aligned with business objectives.
Build, test and maintain automated data pipelines, applications and system integrations, ensuring performance, reliability, security and compliance with technical specifications.
Investigate system inefficiencies and troubleshoot technical issues, implementing enhancements to optimise data processing and operational efficiency.
Liaise with stakeholders to gather and document business requirements, and prepare functional/technical specifications translating business needs into system solutions.
Develop, maintain and optimise program code, databases and technical documentation while ensuring compliance with established quality standards and best practices.
Support software deployments, system upgrades and testing procedures as part of continuous improvement initiatives.
Monitor system performance and data quality, analyse operational metrics, and provide recommendations on system design, automation and data governance.

Essential Requirements:

Relevant qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.
At least 1 year of relevant experience

Salary for the position is $77000 – $85000 per annum plus superannuation

WHO IS PRA?   

PRA is a leading Digital & IT Recruitment company with offices in Brisbane, Sydney, Canberra and Melbourne.
  
PRA offers all its employees’ industry leading financial incentives, flexible working arrangements, training and genuine career growth in Melbourne and interstate.
 
Some of the key benefits are;

- High financial rewards with commission up to 50%
- Cloud based technology, so you can work from home or on the move
- External / Internal training and continuous improvement programs
- Career opportunities into management
- Work Perks such as up to 25 days leave per year, team events, lunch clubs, sales comps and many more.  
  
What is the role?   
Working out of our very cool Melbourne office, you will build your own accounts and networks. We will help you to develop your business and ensure your success as a best in class recruitment and technology professional.

You are able to work on both contract and permanent roles and you can build up significant revenue streams whilst placing permanent candidates. 

We have multiple positions available, such as:

- Candidate Manager 
- Associate Consultatant
- Recruitment Consultant
- Senior Consultant
- Managing Consultant
- Principal Consultant
- Client Services Manager 

Consultants within PRA are responsible to develop long term relationships with clients and to offer a professional and effective service to clients and candidates.  Delivery and the style of the delivery are paramount to maintain and develop the image of PRA as a leading supplier of recruitment solutions.
What will you do?
- Selling and promoting PRA’s services to existing and new customers
- Expanding PRA’s reach within each customer through business development activities
- Managing and maintaining client accounts for PRA’s services through consistent communication and client visits
- Assessing clients’ needs and providing services and solutions that satisfy client requirements
- Co-ordinating with PRA’s internal resources to ensure customers receive best in class service
- Providing timely and regular reporting to both internal and external stakeholders
- Utilising market knowledge to pitch new clients and win new business
- Dealing with clients & candidates, developing long term effective relationships
- Negotiating rates with clients, both contract and permanent
- Giving presentations to clients
- Handling clients and applicants through recruitment process to successful conclusion
- Writing advertisement copy
- Selection of applicants for vacancies
- Interviewing applicants
- Arranging interviews with clients and candidates
- Ensuring contact is made on a regular basis with contractors once placed out on the client’s site
- Maintaining awareness of trends within area of technical specialisation
- Ensuring that contact is made with clients on a regular basis and updating the database

What kind of person thrives in the PRA environment?   

Communication and people management are the defining elements of this role.  To perform it successfully, a candidate will need to be confident, and possess the ability to inform and persuade others and effectively present both themselves and the organisation they represent.  Friendliness and charisma are important factors in performing such a job effectively, together with the ability to put others at their ease.

Attention to detail, responsiveness and adaptability are also key elements in this job.  You will have energy and enthusiasm, and the ability to deal confidently with changes in work environments and situations.  The job often calls for work to meet deadlines or be completed within short timescales, and the ideal candidates will be prepared to commit themselves if they are to succeed.

Recruitment is challenging and fast-moving, and there are times you will practice patience to see through a difficult time or a minor repetitive task.  Having said this, you will see that these periods as necessary to your personal advancement and will contribute to your own goals in life, and in return you will work towards a career that is rewarding and flexible!
What will you have done before?   
- Min 3 years experience working with a range of stakeholders within the recruitment industry
- Excellent communication skills, both written & verbal
- Working autonomously & within a team, doing everything in your power to ensure your colleagues success as well as your own- recognising that the greater teams’ success will always benefit you personally
- Attention to detail and an enjoyment of being busy; managing multiple moving pieces at one time
- Min 3 years experience in a Business Development capacity or understanding of what is involved in this process
- A background in technology will be a huge bonus!

This role attracts a Base salary of $89,000- $100,000 Pkg + OTE  

Apply now for immediate consideration

result.description:
Position: Retail Store Manager
Location: Gold Coast Pacific Fair – Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, 2–30 Hooker Boulevard, Broadbeach QLD 4218?
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time?
Hours: 38 hours per week?
Salary: AUD $85,000–$90,000 per annum, plus superannuation

This advertisement is posted by Comandini Migration Services on behalf of Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd.

About Us
Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd is a premium fashion retailer specialising in luxury sneakers, clothing, footwear, bags and accessories. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products and exceptional customer service.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Retail Store Manager to lead our store operations, drive sales growth and deliver a world-class customer experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving commercial objectives, managing and developing the store team, maintaining brand and visual merchandising standards, and ensuring the efficient operation of the store.
This role requires a reliable, empowering and supportive leader with strong commercial awareness, excellent communication skills and proven experience managing a premium retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
Sales and Customer Experience
* Manage store sales targets and monitor performance through relevant key performance indicators.
* Develop and implement action plans in consultation with the Area Manager to improve sales performance.
* Lead and motivate the team to achieve commercial targets while maintaining high customer service standards.
* Ensure employees consistently follow the company’s selling processes, including up-selling, cross-selling and promoting available services.
* Provide customers with accurate information regarding products, pricing, services and expected timeframes.
* Build strong customer relationships through personalised service and regular follow-up.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction.
* Build relationships with the local community and act as a brand ambassador to attract new customers and retain existing clients.
* Manage customer database development, segmentation and profiling.
* Drive in-store and omnichannel sales by effectively using available systems, tools and technology.

Business and Network Development
* Support the Area Manager in developing long-term market growth strategies.
* Establish and maintain commercial relationships and partnerships within the local market.
* Monitor relevant retail and industry trends.
* Identify and recommend sales opportunities and business development initiatives.

Brand and Product Management
* Represent and promote the company’s brand values, heritage and vision.
* Ensure employees have a strong understanding of the brand, products and services.
* Monitor the store’s product assortment and provide feedback to Area Management and the Buying Team regarding customer and market demand.
* Oversee the overall presentation of the store.
* Maintain high visual merchandising and product display standards in accordance with company guidelines.
* Ensure the team remains informed and trained on all product collections and categories.
Team Leadership and Human Resources
* Recruit, manage, develop, motivate and empower store employees.
* Build a positive and supportive workplace culture based on trust, professionalism and accountability.
* Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, training and performance development.
* Conduct daily and weekly store briefings to communicate objectives, priorities and sales strategies.
* Support new employees throughout the onboarding process.
* Ensure employees comply with company grooming and uniform standards.
* Work closely with the Area Manager and Human Resources team to recruit suitable employees.
* Manage employee performance and implement appropriate improvement measures where required.
* Prepare staff rosters and ensure appropriate staffing levels are maintained.

Store Operations and Compliance
* Supervise and coordinate all store activities to ensure efficient daily operations.
* Ensure compliance with the company’s standard operating procedures.
* Oversee stock and back-of-house operations, including receiving and transferring stock, stocktaking, stock control, storage, reporting and store administration.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, privacy obligations, workplace health and safety requirements and other applicable regulations.
* Use relevant retail, customer relationship management and point-of-sale systems.
* Ensure employees are appropriately trained in all operational and digital systems.

Skills and Experience
The successful candidate will have:
* Relevant experience managing a retail store or comparable retail operation.
* Demonstrated experience leading, developing and motivating a retail team.
* Strong knowledge of retail sales, customer service and store operations.
* Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage key performance indicators.
* Experience in stock management, visual merchandising and operational compliance.
* Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership and interpersonal skills.
* The ability to build strong relationships with customers, employees and business stakeholders.
* Experience using point-of-sale, customer relationship management and other retail management systems.
* The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Experience in premium, luxury or fashion retail will be highly regarded.
